maps.from_field: raw.row.1．2: Does the format have a published open specification?
maps.rationale: NARA question 1.2 directly asks whether a published open specification exists. Stored values are rubric scores, so the resulting observation is recorded as derived source evidence.

maps.from_field: raw.row.3．2: Is there an internal signature in an authoritative format registry that can be used to identify a file in this format?
maps.rationale: NARA question 3.2 directly supports technical identifiability.
